What we know:
• The projection simulates the policy month by month, from the start date to the maturity date, as if the
funds grew every month at the assumed yearly rate of NRILLU.
• It is a simplified accounting: there are no real fund prices, no currencies and no individual agreements,
and the whole value is treated as one amount.
• The diagnostic file shows the projected value at the end of every policy year. Use it to find out where
your projection starts to differ.
Result: {policy id: maturity value}, file t2 projected maturity value.csv. The diagnostic file
t2 projection year.csv contains the projected value at the end of every policy year.
Example: BL10000013,109748.88.

t3 Surrender value
Goal: calculate the surrender value of every policy on the given valuation dates.
Why: the surrender value is the most important number in the system. It is what a customer gets if they end the
policy, and it is the basis of the company’s balance sheet.
What we know:
• Charges cancel units: On every monthly anniversary, Neuron takes the admin fee, the management
charge (with a different rate per pot) and the risk charge by cancelling units in all funds and pots. These
bookings exist in NRBOOK, but their amounts and units are missing, so you have to calculate them.
• Customer orders are complete: Fund switches, withdrawals and surrenders are orders of the customer,
and their bookings are complete in the export. Reversed events and technical corrections can be ignored.
• Surrender value: Value the units at the redemption price (the last price on or before the valuation date)
in the policy currency.
• Surrendered policies and policies of insured persons who died are worth 0.
Result: {(policy id, valuation date): surrender value}, file t3 surrender value.csv. The train targets
use the valuation dates 2006-12-31, 2020-04-30 and 2025-12-31. Three diagnostic files help to check each step:
t3 booking.csv (amounts and units of the missing bookings), t3 holding.csv (units per fund and pot) and
the column policy value (value before the penalty).
Example: BL10000013,2025-12-31,31111.18,31111.18.
4

 t4 Annual statement
Goal: calculate the annual statement of every policy and calendar year, from the start year to the year the policy
ends by surrender or death, at the latest 2025.
Why: every year, each customer receives a statement of what they paid and what the policy cost them. The law
requires this cost transparency, and the numbers must be consistent with the fund accounting.
What we know: a statement has six columns. The charges are exactly the ones that Neuron takes from the policy
in the fund accounting of t3, so t3 and t4 are best solved together.
premiums

premiums received in the year (money date)

entry charges

entry charges on the premiums invested in the year (trade date)

admin fees

admin fees deducted in the year

management fees

management charges deducted in the year

risk charges

risk charges deducted in the year

total charges

entry + admin + management + risk

Result: {(policy id, year): (premiums, entry charges, admin fees, management fees, risk charges,
total charges)}, file t4 annual statement.csv.
Example: BL10000013,2021,2835.00,103.95,78.00,187.88,69.64,439.47.

t5 Outliers (bonus)
Goal: find the values in all previous tasks that were overwritten by hand.
Why: manual corrections follow no rule, so the new system cannot calculate them. A migration team must find
them and take them over one by one.
What we know:
• some are listed in NREXCP, but not all.
• some tasks have outliers, while some might not.
• unlike the other tasks, t5 gets the target files of the policies it has to check, in the same format as
targets/. A value that differs from what your rules calculate is either a manual correction or a rule you
have not found yet.
Result: a set of (task, key), for example ("t2 projected maturity value", "BL10000042") or ("t4 annual statement",
("BL10000042", 2021)). It is compared with all known manual corrections, listed or not, using the F1 score.

t6 Visualization/Tools (bonus)
Goal: show the visualizations and tools you used to find and explain the rules.
Why: a good visualization makes a hidden rule visible at a glance, for a person or as input for another model. In
a real migration, it is also how the team convinces the client that the rules are right.
Ideas:
• the differences between your values and the targets, over the application date or the processing date
• the differences over the number of days to the next birthday
• a calendar heat map of due dates and collection dates
• a waterfall chart of an annual statement
• the timeline of one policy: premiums, charges, units and value
• the distribution of cent differences per task
5

 6

Where AI Comes In

The tasks are too many and too detailed to solve by hand in one weekend. The teams that do best will let AI do
most of the work. Classic machine learning, search methods and language models all have their place:
• Find where a rule changes: train a decision tree or a rule learner to predict which rows your current
rule gets wrong. Its splits point to hidden conditions, for example “application date before a certain day”
or “product family X”. Change-point detection on the differences over time finds the dates when the system
behaved differently.
• Find the formula: linear or robust regression recovers rates and factors from inputs and outputs. Symbolic
regression and program synthesis search for the expression that matches the targets exactly, including rounding
and date rules.
• Find the structure: clustering groups policies that behave in the same way, and feature importance shows
which columns matter for a target. Both help to decide where to look first.
• Find the noise: anomaly detection (for example an isolation forest on the remaining differences) separates
the manual corrections from rules you have not found yet (bonus task t5).
• Build the tools with LLMs: language models are very good at writing the code around the search: data
loaders for the old formats, policy timeline viewers, dashboards of differences and other visualizations. Such
tools make the data easier to understand, for a person, for a machine learning model or for another LLM. An
LLM can also turn the conditions found by a decision tree into readable code, or propose rules from a task
description.
The strongest solutions will combine these methods into one approach that works for all tasks, and for new targets
too, instead of solving each task in a different way.

7

Submission

A submission is a Python package with one entry point, submission.py, which defines one function per task. Each
function gets the path legacy dir of a folder with the NR*.csv files and returns the calculated values. Dates are
datetime.date, amounts are decimal.Decimal. A missing function scores 0 for its task.
def t0 commission(legacy dir) -> dict[tuple[str, int], Decimal]
def t1 next due dates(legacy dir, extract date) -> dict[tuple[str, int], tuple[date, date]]
def t2 projected maturity value(legacy dir) -> dict[str, Decimal]
def t3 surrender value(legacy dir, valuation dates) -> dict[tuple[str, date], Decimal]
def t4 annual statement(legacy dir) -> dict[tuple[str, int], tuple[Decimal, ...]]
def t5 outlier detection(legacy dir, targets dir) -> set[tuple[str, object]]
• Python only, any library: you can use any external library. List them in a requirements.txt file. The
evaluator installs them and runs your code offline on the private data, within a fixed time limit.
• Rules, not results: your code must calculate every value from the data it receives. It must not read the
target files or contain target values. The only exception is t5, which gets the folder targets dir with the
target files of the policies to check. The private policies are unseen, so memorizing does not help anyway.
• Show your work: add the tools and visualizations you built, and a short README.md that explains your
approach and the rules you found.

6

 How you find the rules is completely up to you. The Python code is only the output format of the underlying
formula, and it can be produced in many ways: generated from the conditions of a decision tree or a formula found
by symbolic regression, written by an LLM from such a formal input, or written by hand using what your models
found in the data. We ask for Python because a formula written as code is the most general format: every approach,
from pure machine learning to hand-written rules, can produce it, and every result can be run and checked in the
same way.
You can test your solution locally with the files in targets/. They have the same format as the evaluation data.

8

Evaluation

In insurance “almost right” is not enough, so a value counts only if it is exact: an amount must be right to the cent,
and a date right to the day. A row of the annual statement counts only if all six columns match. Outlier values are
not scored. Solutions are evaluated in these ways:
• Accuracy: the share of exactly correct rows of each task, from 0 to 1, on the public and private policies.
Every correct row counts, so even a simple first version earns points, and every rule you find adds more. A
task where all rows are correct earns extra points as a “perfect match” bonus.
• Maintainability: the new system must be maintained for many years, so the code should be easy to read and
change. We measure the maintainability index of your Python code with the radon library. It combines the
size of the code (Halstead volume and lines of code), its cyclomatic complexity and its share of comments into
one number between 0 and 100, where higher is better. Short, simple functions with a generic formula, few
branches and useful comments raise the index. Only the source files for the tasks will be taken into account.
This means for the tools/visualizations your are not even restricted to python.
• Bonus tasks: points for the outliers of t5 (F1 score against all known manual corrections on the public and
private policies) and for the visualizations of t6.
• Generalization: points for approaches that can be applied to new problems. If the client asks for the formula
of another target tomorrow, how much work would it be to apply your approach to it? Approaches that find
rules automatically, with tools that are not built for a single task, score best here.
• Live Leaderboard: a public leaderboard shows the accuracy of each task on the public policies and the
maintainability index of each submission, so teams can follow their progress during the hackathon.

9

Proposed Approach

There is no single correct method, but here is one way that works. Our own reference solution gets 100 % on every
task with fewer than 300 lines of Python. Most steps can be done or supported by AI.
1. Understand the data: load the tables, decode the old date formats and code lists, and follow one policy
from application to surrender: premiums, events, bookings. A policy timeline viewer, for example written
with the help of an LLM, is worth building early.
2. Start with the story: turn the business description of a task into a first, simple implementation. The result
is usually correct for most rows.
3. Look at the mistakes: compare with the train targets and study the rows that do not match. Plot the
differences against the application date, the processing date, the cents of the amount or the days to the next
birthday. Let a decision tree or change-point detection find the pattern. Sudden jumps point to system
changes, and repeating patterns point to hidden conventions such as rounding, day counting or holidays.
4. Test ideas automatically: turn each pattern into a few possible rules, and test each rule for exact matches
on the train data. A symbolic search can try all combinations of rounding modes, date shifts and parameter
lookups, regression can recover unknown factors, and an LLM can suggest new candidate rules.

7

 5. Use the diagnostics: for the hard tasks, the intermediate targets (projected values per year, fund units,
single charge bookings) let you check each step of the calculation, not only the final number.
6. Separate rules from noise: when the rules explain almost everything, what is left is either a rule you have
not found yet, or a value changed by hand. Anomaly detection helps to tell them apart, which is the bonus
task t5.
A good solution is more than a high score. It is clear code that a developer can maintain and an auditor can check.
The best teams will build an AI-driven method that can find such rules for any legacy system, not only the answers
for this one.

10

Additional Information

You do not need any knowledge of insurance or finance. The task descriptions, the Key Terms in the appendix and
SCHEMA.md explain probably everything you need. In this data, curiosity and good tools matter more than domain
knowledge.

Key Terms

These are all the terms used in the tasks. On the right you find the tables or columns where the term appears in
the data; SCHEMA.md has the details.

Policy and people

    out['each']=tot(lambda u,f: cents(u*price(f,d)*xr(f)))

    out['fx6_each']=tot(lambda u,f: cents(u*price(f,d)*xr(f).quantize(Q6)))

for kk in sorted(potc,key=str): print(kk,potc[kk])

from mkt import *

tbm={r['booking_id']:r for r in tb}
rev={(r['EV_POLNR'],r['EV_REVNR']) for r in ev.values() if r['EV_EVTTP']==900}
Q6=Decimal('0.000001'); SC=dt.date(2007,8,11)
bypol=defaultdict(list)
for r in bk:
    if (r['BK_POLNR'],r['BK_EVTNR']) in rev or ev[(r['BK_POLNR'],r['BK_EVTNR'])]['EV_EVTTP']==990: continue
    t=tbm.get(r['BK_BOOKID'])
    r['units']=r['BK_UNITS'] if r['BK_UNITS'] is not None else Decimal(t['units'])
    bypol[r['BK_POLNR']].append(r)
c=Counter(); ex=defaultdict(list)
for p,rows in bypol.items():
    rows.sort(key=lambda r:r['BK_BOOKID'])
    ccy=latest(pol[p],'PH')['PH_CCY']
    hold=defaultdict(Decimal)
    i=0
    while i<len(rows):
        e=rows[i]['BK_EVTNR']; rs=[]
        while i<len(rows) and rows[i]['BK_EVTNR']==e: rs.append(rows[i]); i+=1
        typ=rs[0]['BK_BKTYP']
        if typ not in ('ADM','AMC','RSK','PRM'):
            E=ev[(p,e)]; d=rs[0]['BK_TRDDT']; rd=ROUND_DOWN if d<SC else ROUND_HALF_UP
            outs=[r for r in rs if r['BK_UNITS']<0]; ins=[r for r in rs if r['BK_UNITS']>0]
            for r in rs:
                f=r['BK_FNDID']; fc=funds[f]['FD_CCY']
                k=(r['BK_BKTYP'],d<SC)
                c[k+('trd=eff',r['BK_TRDDT']==E['EV_EFFDT'])]+=1
                c[k+('prc=last',r['BK_PRCDT']==last(pdates[f],r['BK_TRDDT']))]+=1
                pc='bid' if r['BK_PRICE']==price(f,r['BK_PRCDT']) else 'ask' if r['BK_PRICE']==price(f,r['BK_PRCDT'],'FP_ASKPR') else '?'
                c[k+('price',pc)]+=1
                fxr=(rate(fc,d)/rate(ccy,d))
                c[k+('fx',r['BK_FXRAT']==fxr.quantize(Q6), r['BK_FXRAT']==(1/(rate(ccy,d)/rate(fc,d))).quantize(Q6))]+=1
                if r['BK_UNITS']<0:
                    h=hold[(f,r['BK_POTCD'])]

"""Scratch simulator of t3 (pure python, the same helpers as the submission)."""
import sys, bisect, datetime as dt
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_DOWN, ROUND_HALF_UP
sys.path.insert(0,'/Users/antonio/dev/ch-Fable-7.4-off/starter_kit/my_solution')
from neuron import table, grouped, keyed, valid, latest, cents, add_months, age, day
from collections import defaultdict
SC=dt.date(2007,8,11); Q6=Decimal('0.000001')

def last_on(dates, d):
    return dates[bisect.bisect_right(dates, d)-1]

class Market:
    def __init__(self, L):
        self.px={}
        for r in table(L,'NRFPRC'):
            k=(r['FP_FNDID'],r['FP_PRCDT'])
            if k not in self.px or r['FP_CHGTS']>self.px[k]['FP_CHGTS']: self.px[k]=r
        self.pdates=defaultdict(list)
        for f,d in sorted(self.px): self.pdates[f].append(d)
        self.fx={(r['FX_CCY'].upper(),r['FX_RATDT']):r['FX_RATE'] for r in table(L,'NRFXRT')}
        self.fdates=defaultdict(list)
        for c,d in sorted(self.fx): self.fdates[c].append(d)
        self.ccy={r['FD_FNDID']:r['FD_CCY'] for r in table(L,'NRFUND')}
    def price_date(self,f,d): return last_on(self.pdates[f],d)
    def next_price_date(self,f,d): return self.pdates[f][bisect.bisect_right(self.pdates[f],d)]
    def price(self,f,d,col='FP_BIDPR'): return self.px[f,self.price_date(f,d)][col]
    def rate(self,c,d): return self.fx[c,last_on(self.fdates[c],d)]
    def to_policy(self,f,ccy,d): return self.rate(self.ccy[f],d)/self.rate(ccy,d)

def policy_years(beg,d):
    k=age(beg,d)
    while add_months(beg,12*(k+1))<=d: k+=1
    return k

def run(L, valuation_dates, policies=None, trace=None):
    mk=Market(L)
    pols=grouped(table(L,'NRPOLH'),'PH_POLNR'); risks=keyed(table(L,'NRRISK'),'RK_POLNR')
    pers=keyed(table(L,'NRPERS'),'PS_PERNR'); prods=keyed(table(L,'NRPROD'),'PD_PRDCD')
    chrg=grouped(table(L,'NRCHRG'),'CG_TARFAM','CG_TARGEN'); mort=keyed(table(L,'NRMORT'),'MO_TABID','MO_SEX','MO_AGE')
    entc=grouped(table(L,'NRENTC'),'EC_TIER'); brok=keyed(table(L,'NRBROK'),'BR_BRKNR')
    agre=grouped(table(L,'NRAGRE'),'AG_POLNR','AG_FEETP'); allo=grouped(table(L,'NRALLO'),'AL_POLNR')
    surr={(r['SR_SCALE'],r['SR_YEAR']):r['SR_RATE'] for r in table(L,'NRSURR')}; waiv=table(L,'NRWAIV')
    evs=grouped(table(L,'NREVNT'),'EV_POLNR'); prem=grouped(table(L,'NRPREM'),'PR_POLNR')
    out={}
    for p,versions in pols.items():
        if policies and p not in policies: continue
        first=min(versions,key=lambda v:v['PH_VRSNR']); ccy=latest(versions,'PH')['PH_CCY']
        beg=first['PH_BEGDT']; rk=risks[p]; tk=rk['RK_TARKEY']; per=pers[rk['RK_PERNR']]
        birth=per['PS_BIRTH'] or day(per['PS_BIRTH_RAW'],month_end=True)
        sex={'M':'1','W':'2'}.get(tk[2],per['PS_SEX'])
        cobol=first['PH_APPDT']<SC
        ini_end=add_months(beg,prods[first['PH_PRDCD']]['PD_INIMON'])
        def agreed(fee,d):
            for a in agre.get((p,fee),[]):
                if a['AG_VLDFR']<=d<=a['AG_VLDTO']: return a['AG_RATE']
        evp=evs.get(p,[])
        reversed_={e['EV_REVNR'] for e in evp if e['EV_EVTTP']==900}
        items=[]
        for e in evp:
            if e['EV_EVTNR'] in reversed_: continue
            if e['EV_EVTTP'] in (300,200,400,410,500):
                items.append((e['EV_EFFDT'], 0 if e['EV_EVTTP']==300 else 1, e['EV_EVTNR'], e, None))
        for pr in prem.get(p,[]):
            if pr['PR_STATE']!='P': continue
            d=pr['PR_RCVDT']
            ag=agreed('ENT',d)
            if ag is None:
                ph=valid(versions,'PH',d)
                ag=valid(entc[brok[ph['PH_BRKNR']]['BR_TIER']],'EC',d)['EC_RATE']
            al=[a for a in allo[p] if a['AL_VLDFR']<=d<=a['AL_VLDTO']]
            vr=max(a['AL_VRSNR'] for a in al)
            for a in al:
                if a['AL_VRSNR']!=vr: continue
                f=a['AL_FNDID']
                items.append((mk.next_price_date(f,d),1,pr['PR_EVTNR'],pr,(f,a['AL_PCTG'],ag)))
        items.sort(key=lambda x:(x[0],x[1],x[2]))
        hold=defaultdict(Decimal); vds=sorted(valuation_dates); snaps={}; vi=0
        prev_run=beg
        for d,_,_,obj,extra in items:
            while vi<len(vds) and vds[vi]<d: snaps[vds[vi]]=dict(hold); vi+=1
            rd=ROUND_DOWN if d<SC else ROUND_HALF_UP
            def units(amount,f,pd,fxd,col='FP_BIDPR'):
                return (amount/(mk.price(f,pd,col)*mk.to_policy(f,ccy,fxd))).quantize(Q6,rd)
            def value(k): return cents(hold[k]*mk.price(k[0],d)*mk.to_policy(k[0],ccy,d),rd)
            if extra:  # premium
                f,share,ent=extra; pr=obj
                amount=cents(pr['PR_AMTRC']*(1-ent)*share,rd)
                pot='1' if pr['PR_RCVDT']<ini_end else '2'
                u=(amount/(mk.price(f,d,'FP_ASKPR')*mk.to_policy(f,ccy,pr['PR_RCVDT']))).quantize(Q6,rd)
                hold[f,pot]+=u
                if trace is not None: trace.append((p,obj['PR_EVTNR'],'PRM',f,pot,amount,u))
                continue
            e=obj; tp=e['EV_EVTTP']
            keys=[k for k,u in hold.items() if u>0]
            if tp==300:
                tar=valid(chrg[tk[:2],tk[3:5]],'CG',d)
                vals={k:value(k) for k in keys}
                V=sum(vals.values())
                if not keys: prev_run=d; continue
                def split(total):
                    res={k:cents(total*v/V,rd) if V else Decimal(0) for k,v in vals.items()}
                    big=max(vals,key=lambda k:vals[k]); res[big]+=total-sum(res.values()); return res
                adm=split(tar['CG_ADMFEE'])
                amc={}
                for k in keys:
                    rate=agreed('AMC',d)
                    if rate is None: rate=tar['CG_AMCP1'] if k[1]=='1' else tar['CG_AMCP2']
                    amc[k]=cents(vals[k]*rate*(d-prev_run).days/360,rd) if d<SC else cents(vals[k]*rate/12,rd)
                net=V-sum(adm.values())-sum(amc.values())
                yrs=policy_years(beg,d)
                if cobol: a=((beg-birth).days+182)//365+yrs
                else: a=age(birth,add_months(add_months(beg,12*yrs),6))
                q=mort[tar['CG_MORTTB'],sex,a]['MO_QX']
                sm=tar['CG_SMKFAC'] if per['PS_SMOKE'] in ('Y','J') else 1
                sar={'A':net/100,'B':max(rk['RK_SUMIN']-net,0),'C':rk['RK_SUMIN']}[tk[6]]
                rsk=split(cents(sar*q*(1+rk['RK_LOAD'])*sm/12,rd))
                for k in keys:
                    for typ,amt in (('ADM',adm[k]),('AMC',amc[k]),('RSK',rsk[k])):
                        u=units(-amt,k[0],d,d)
                        hold[k]+=u
                        if trace is not None: trace.append((p,e['EV_EVTNR'],typ,k[0],k[1],amt,u))
                prev_run=d
            else:
                pct=e['EV_PCTG']
                src=[k for k in keys if tp!=200 or k[0]==e['EV_FNDID']]
                for k in src:
                    u=-(hold[k]*pct).quantize(Q6,rd)
                    amt=cents(u*mk.price(k[0],d)*mk.to_policy(k[0],ccy,d),rd)
                    hold[k]+=u
                    if trace is not None: trace.append((p,e['EV_EVTNR'],'OUT',k[0],k[1],amt,u))
                    if tp==200:
                        k2=(e['EV_TOFND'],k[1]); u2=units(-amt,k2[0],d,d)
                        hold[k2]+=u2
                        if trace is not None: trace.append((p,e['EV_EVTNR'],'SWI',k2[0],k2[1],-amt,u2))
        while vi<len(vds): snaps[vds[vi]]=dict(hold); vi+=1
        prod=prods[first['PH_PRDCD']]
        for vd in vds:
            if beg>vd: continue
            rd=ROUND_DOWN if vd<SC else ROUND_HALF_UP
            ph=valid(versions,'PH',vd)
            pv=sum((cents(u*mk.price(f,vd)*mk.to_policy(f,ccy,vd),rd) for (f,pot),u in snaps[vd].items() if u), Decimal(0))
            rate=surr.get((prod['PD_SRPSCL'],policy_years(beg,vd)),0)
            if any(w['WV_VLDFR']<=vd<=w['WV_VLDTO'] for w in waiv): rate=0
            sv=Decimal(0) if ph['PH_STATE'] in (60,70) else max(cents(pv*(1-rate),rd),Decimal(0))
            out[p,vd]=(sv,pv)
    return out

"""Neuron migration challenge: the formulas found by the lab pipeline (clustering + optimal trees + exact score).

Each function gets the folder `legacy_dir` with the NR*.csv files and returns the calculated values.
Dates are `datetime.date`, amounts are `decimal.Decimal`. Every value is calculated from `legacy_dir`; only
t5 reads target files. The shared helpers (typed tables, versions, rounding) are in `neuron.py`.
"""
import datetime as dt
from decimal import ROUND_DOWN, ROUND_HALF_UP, Decimal

from neuron import cents, grouped, keyed, read_targets, table, valid
from neuron import add_months, age, day, easter, months_between


def t0_commission(legacy_dir):
    """amount = PR_AMTRC x NRCOMR.CR_RATE[CR_TIER = BR_TIER@PR_RCVDT, CR_PAYTP = RK_TARKEY[6]], ROUND_HALF_UP.

    Lab candidate C3.1.1: 225848 / 225858 train rows exact (holdout 44051 / 44052).
    """
    commission_rates = keyed(table(legacy_dir, "NRCOMR"), "CR_TIER", "CR_PAYTP")
    policy_headers = grouped(table(legacy_dir, "NRPOLH"), "PH_POLNR")
    brokers = keyed(table(legacy_dir, "NRBROK"), "BR_BRKNR")
    insured_risks = keyed(table(legacy_dir, "NRRISK"), "RK_POLNR")
    result = {}
    for premium_item in table(legacy_dir, "NRPREM"):
        if premium_item["PR_STATE"] == "P":
            policy_header = valid(policy_headers[premium_item["PR_POLNR"]], "PH", premium_item["PR_RCVDT"])
            broker = brokers[policy_header["PH_BRKNR"]]
            insured_risk = insured_risks[premium_item["PR_POLNR"]]
            commission_rate = commission_rates[broker["BR_TIER"], insured_risk["RK_TARKEY"][5]]["CR_RATE"]
            result[premium_item["PR_POLNR"], premium_item["PR_DUENR"]] = cents(premium_item["PR_AMTRC"] * commission_rate)
    return result


MONTHS_PER_DUE = {"M": 1, "Q": 3, "H": 6, "J": 12}  # NRCODE FREQ; E (single premium) has no due dates
SYSTEM_CHANGE = dt.date(2007, 8, 11)
FIXED_HOLIDAYS = {(1, 1), (1, 6), (3, 19), (5, 1), (6, 29), (8, 1), (8, 15), (11, 1), (12, 8), (12, 25), (12, 26)}
EASTER_HOLIDAYS = (1, 39, 50, 60)  # days after Easter: Easter Monday, Ascension, Whit Monday, Corpus Christi


def is_bank_holiday(day):
    """Weekend or holiday of the Ticino calendar (Good Friday is a working day)."""
    return (day.weekday() >= 5 or (day.month, day.day) in FIXED_HOLIDAYS
            or (day - easter(day.year)).days in EASTER_HOLIDAYS)


def t1_next_due_dates(legacy_dir, extract_date: dt.date) -> dict[tuple[str, int], tuple[dt.date, dt.date]]:
    """{(policy_id, n): (due_date, collection_date)} for the due dates in the year after `extract_date`, n = 1, 2, ...

    Policies in force and premium paying (PH_STATE 10) on the extract date. Before the system change the due
    dates were computed one from the other, so a day missing in a month (the 31st) stuck for good; since then
    they are counted from the last due date before the change. Direct debits (LS) are collected on the next
    bank working day, bank transfers (UB) on the due date.
    """
    year_end = add_months(extract_date, 12)
    result = {}
    for policy_id, versions in grouped(table(legacy_dir, "NRPOLH"), "PH_POLNR").items():
        policy_header = valid(versions, "PH", extract_date)
        months = MONTHS_PER_DUE.get(policy_header["PH_FREQ"])
        if policy_header["PH_STATE"] != 10 or not months:
            continue
        anchor = policy_header["PH_BEGDT"]
        while add_months(anchor, months) < SYSTEM_CHANGE:
            anchor = add_months(anchor, months)
        elapsed = (extract_date.year - anchor.year) * 12 + extract_date.month - anchor.month
        k = max(elapsed // months - 1, 0)  # a due number before the extract date, 0 = the begin date
        n = 0
        while (due_date := add_months(anchor, k * months)) <= year_end:
            if due_date > extract_date:
                collection_date = due_date
                while policy_header["PH_PAYMT"] == "LS" and is_bank_holiday(collection_date):
                    collection_date += dt.timedelta(days=1)
                n += 1
                result[policy_id, n] = due_date, collection_date
            k += 1
    return result


SMOKER = {"Y", "J"}  # NRPERS.PS_SMOKE: J (German ja) also means yes


def t2_projected_maturity_value(legacy_dir) -> dict[str, Decimal]:
    """{policy_id: maturity_value}, the value projected by the offer: the first policy version, with the
    parameters valid on the application date.

    Every month from the start date: the premium net of the entry charge comes in on its due months, then the
    admin fee, the management charge (pot 2 rate) and the risk charge go out, then the value grows by a twelfth
    of the yearly NRILLU rate. The risk charge uses the entry age plus the completed policy years.
    The COBOL version (offers applied before the system change) cuts the cents off and takes the entry age as
    days / 365, rounded; the Java version rounds half up and takes the age at the nearest birthday.
    """
    policy_headers = grouped(table(legacy_dir, "NRPOLH"), "PH_POLNR")
    brokers = keyed(table(legacy_dir, "NRBROK"), "BR_BRKNR")
    persons = keyed(table(legacy_dir, "NRPERS"), "PS_PERNR")
    tariffs = grouped(table(legacy_dir, "NRCHRG"), "CG_TARFAM", "CG_TARGEN")
    entry_rates = grouped(table(legacy_dir, "NRENTC"), "EC_TIER")
    mortality = keyed(table(legacy_dir, "NRMORT"), "MO_TABID", "MO_SEX", "MO_AGE")
    result = {}
    for insured_risk in table(legacy_dir, "NRRISK"):
        offer = min(policy_headers[insured_risk["RK_POLNR"]], key=lambda version: version["PH_VRSNR"])
        applied, start = offer["PH_APPDT"], offer["PH_BEGDT"]
        tariff_key = insured_risk["RK_TARKEY"]
        tariff = valid(tariffs[tariff_key[:2], tariff_key[3:5]], "CG", applied)
        entry_rate = valid(entry_rates[brokers[offer["PH_BRKNR"]]["BR_TIER"]], "EC", applied)["EC_RATE"]
        growth = 1 + valid(table(legacy_dir, "NRILLU"), "IL", applied)["IL_RATE"] / 12
        person = persons[insured_risk["RK_PERNR"]]
        birth = person["PS_BIRTH"] or day(person["PS_BIRTH_RAW"], month_end=True)  # 31 September: 30 September
        sex = {"M": "1", "W": "2"}.get(tariff_key[2], person["PS_SEX"])
        smoker_factor = tariff["CG_SMKFAC"] if person["PS_SMOKE"] in SMOKER else 1
        step = MONTHS_PER_DUE.get(offer["PH_FREQ"])  # None: a single premium, paid in month 0 only
        if applied < SYSTEM_CHANGE:
            rounding, entry_age = ROUND_DOWN, ((start - birth).days + 182) // 365
        else:
            rounding, entry_age = ROUND_HALF_UP, age(birth, add_months(start, 6))
        value = Decimal(0)
        for month in range(months_between(start, offer["PH_ENDDT"])):
            if (month % step if step else month) == 0:
                value += cents(offer["PH_PREMI"] * (1 - entry_rate), rounding)
            value -= tariff["CG_ADMFEE"]
            value -= cents(value * tariff["CG_AMCP2"] / 12, rounding)
            death_rate = mortality[tariff["CG_MORTTB"], sex, entry_age + month // 12]["MO_QX"]
            sum_at_risk = {"A": value / 100, "B": max(insured_risk["RK_SUMIN"] - value, 0),
                           "C": insured_risk["RK_SUMIN"]}[tariff_key[6]]
            value -= cents(sum_at_risk * death_rate * (1 + insured_risk["RK_LOAD"]) * smoker_factor / 12, rounding)
            value = cents(value * growth, rounding)
        result[insured_risk["RK_POLNR"]] = value
    return result


def t3_surrender_value(legacy_dir, valuation_dates: list[dt.date]) -> dict[tuple[str, dt.date], Decimal]:
    """{(policy_id, valuation_date): surrender_value}"""
    return {}


def t4_annual_statement(legacy_dir) -> dict[tuple[str, int], tuple[Decimal, ...]]:
    """{(policy_id, year): (premiums, entry_charges, admin_fees, management_fees, risk_charges, total_charges)}"""
    return {}


EXTRACT_DATE = dt.date(2026, 6, 30)  # the extract date of t1_next_due_dates
CHECKED = {  # task: (function, key converters, value converters, its arguments after legacy_dir from targets_dir)
    "t0_commission": (t0_commission, (str, int), (Decimal,), lambda targets_dir: ()),
    "t1_next_due_dates": (t1_next_due_dates, (str, int), (dt.date.fromisoformat,) * 2,
                          lambda targets_dir: (EXTRACT_DATE,)),
    "t2_projected_maturity_value": (t2_projected_maturity_value, (str,), (Decimal,), lambda targets_dir: ()),
}


def t5_outlier_detection(legacy_dir, targets_dir) -> set[tuple[str, object]]:
    """{(task, key)} of the target values that differ from the rules: the values that were changed by hand."""
    outliers = set()
    for task, (rule, key_types, value_types, arguments) in CHECKED.items():
        computed = rule(legacy_dir, *arguments(targets_dir))
        for key, value in read_targets(targets_dir, task, key_types, value_types).items():
            if key in computed and computed[key] != value:
                outliers.add((task, key))
    return outliers

from decimal import ROUND_DOWN, ROUND_HALF_UP, Decimal
from neuron import cents, grouped, keyed, read_targets, table, valid
from neuron import add_months, age, day, easter, months_between

input.new_string:
REDEMPTION, ISSUE = "FP_BIDPR", "FP_ASKPR"  # NRFPRC: units are sold at the bid and bought at the ask price
UNIT = Decimal("0.000001")
CHARGE_RUN, SWITCH = 300, 200  # NRCODE EVTTP
CUSTOMER_ORDERS = {200, 400, 410, 500}  # switch, withdrawal, surrender, death claim: EV_PCTG of the units are sold
CLOSED = {60, 70}  # NRCODE STATE: surrendered, death claim


def era_rounding(day_):
    """Neuron NG rounds half up; the COBOL version (before the system change) cuts cents and units off."""
    return ROUND_DOWN if day_ < SYSTEM_CHANGE else ROUND_HALF_UP


def policy_years(start, day_):
    """Completed policy years; a policy that starts on 29 February completes a year on 28 February."""
    years = age(start, day_)
    return years + (add_months(start, 12 * (years + 1)) <= day_)


def split(total, weights, rounding):
    """`total` in proportion to the weights, each part rounded; the largest weight takes the rounding difference."""
    total_weight = sum(weights.values()) or 1
    parts = {key: cents(total * weight / total_weight, rounding) for key, weight in weights.items()}
    parts[max(weights, key=weights.get)] += total - sum(parts.values())
    return parts


class FundAccount:
    """The units of one policy per (fund, pot), valued and booked in the policy currency."""

    def __init__(self, market, currency):
        self.market, self.currency, self.units = market, currency, defaultdict(Decimal)

    def holdings(self):
        return [key for key, units in self.units.items() if units > 0]

    def value(self, key, day_):
        """Redemption value of one holding on `day_`, rounded to the cent."""
        fx = self.market.fx(key[0], self.currency, day_)
        return cents(self.units[key] * self.market.price(key[0], day_) * fx, era_rounding(day_))

    def book(self, key, amount, day_, fx_day=None, side=REDEMPTION):
        """Buys (amount > 0) or cancels (amount < 0) the units of an amount in the policy currency."""
        unit_price = self.market.price(key[0], day_, side) * self.market.fx(key[0], self.currency, fx_day or day_)
        self.units[key] += (amount / unit_price).quantize(UNIT, era_rounding(day_))


class FundAccounting:
    """Neuron's unit accounting, rebuilt from the premiums, the events, the parameters and the market data.

    NRBOOK is not read: its premium and charge bookings have no amounts, and the units of the customer orders
    follow from EV_PCTG. Reversed events (900) and technical corrections (990) do not count.
    """

    def __init__(self, legacy_dir):
        self.market = Market(legacy_dir)
        self.policies = grouped(table(legacy_dir, "NRPOLH"), "PH_POLNR")
        self.risks = keyed(table(legacy_dir, "NRRISK"), "RK_POLNR")
        self.persons = keyed(table(legacy_dir, "NRPERS"), "PS_PERNR")
        self.products = keyed(table(legacy_dir, "NRPROD"), "PD_PRDCD")
        self.brokers = keyed(table(legacy_dir, "NRBROK"), "BR_BRKNR")
        self.tariffs = grouped(table(legacy_dir, "NRCHRG"), "CG_TARFAM", "CG_TARGEN")
        self.entry_rates = grouped(table(legacy_dir, "NRENTC"), "EC_TIER")
        self.mortality = keyed(table(legacy_dir, "NRMORT"), "MO_TABID", "MO_SEX", "MO_AGE")
        self.agreements = grouped(table(legacy_dir, "NRAGRE"), "AG_POLNR", "AG_FEETP")
        self.allocations = grouped(table(legacy_dir, "NRALLO"), "AL_POLNR")
        self.events = grouped(table(legacy_dir, "NREVNT"), "EV_POLNR")
        self.premiums = grouped(table(legacy_dir, "NRPREM"), "PR_POLNR")

    def agreed_rate(self, policy_id, fee_type, day_):
        """The rate of an individual NRAGRE agreement valid on `day_`, which replaces the tariff rate."""
        for agreement in self.agreements.get((policy_id, fee_type), []):
            if agreement["AG_VLDFR"] <= day_ <= agreement["AG_VLDTO"]:
                return agreement["AG_RATE"]
        return None

    def holdings(self, policy_id, days):
        """{day: FundAccount units} at the end of each of `days`.

        The bookings are processed by trade date; on the same day the charge run comes before the premiums and
        orders, which are processed in the order of their events.
        """
        self.policy_id, versions = policy_id, self.policies[policy_id]
        self.offer, self.risk = min(versions, key=lambda version: version["PH_VRSNR"]), self.risks[policy_id]
        account = FundAccount(self.market, latest(versions, "PH")["PH_CCY"])
        events = self.events.get(policy_id, [])
        reversed_events = {event["EV_REVNR"] for event in events if event["EV_EVTTP"] == 900}
        bookings = [(event["EV_EFFDT"], event["EV_EVTTP"] != CHARGE_RUN, event["EV_EVTNR"],
                     functools.partial(self.charge_run if event["EV_EVTTP"] == CHARGE_RUN else self.order, event))
                    for event in events
                    if event["EV_EVTTP"] in CUSTOMER_ORDERS | {CHARGE_RUN} and event["EV_EVTNR"] not in reversed_events]
        bookings += self.premium_bookings(versions)
        result, pending = {}, sorted(days)
        for trade_day, _, _, book in sorted(bookings, key=lambda booking: booking[:3]):
            while pending and pending[0] < trade_day:
                result[pending.pop(0)] = dict(account.units)
            book(account, trade_day)
        return result | {valuation_date: dict(account.units) for valuation_date in pending}

    def premium_bookings(self, versions):
        """Each paid premium (PR_STATE P) is invested on the first price date of each fund after the money date."""
        bookings = []
        for premium in self.premiums.get(self.policy_id, []):
            received = premium["PR_RCVDT"]
            if premium["PR_STATE"] != "P":
                continue
            entry_rate = self.agreed_rate(self.policy_id, "ENT", received)
            if entry_rate is None:
                broker = self.brokers[valid(versions, "PH", received)["PH_BRKNR"]]
                entry_rate = valid(self.entry_rates[broker["BR_TIER"]], "EC", received)["EC_RATE"]
            allocation = self.allocations[self.policy_id]
            version = valid(allocation, "AL", received)["AL_VRSNR"]
            for share in (share for share in allocation if share["AL_VRSNR"] == version):
                trade_day = self.market.price_day(share["AL_FNDID"], received, after=True)
                invest = functools.partial(self.invest, premium, share, entry_rate)
                bookings.append((trade_day, True, premium["PR_EVTNR"], invest))
        return bookings

                trade_day = self.market.price_day(share["AL_FNDID"], received, after=True)
                invest = functools.partial(self.invest, premium, share, entry_rate)
                bookings.append((trade_day, True, premium["PR_EVTNR"], invest))
        return bookings

    def invest(self, premium, share, entry_rate, account, trade_day):
        """Net premium x allocation share at the ask price; pot 1 for the money received in the initial months."""
        amount = cents(premium["PR_AMTRC"] * (1 - entry_rate) * share["AL_PCTG"], era_rounding(trade_day))
        initial_end = add_months(self.offer["PH_BEGDT"], self.products[self.offer["PH_PRDCD"]]["PD_INIMON"])
        pot = "1" if premium["PR_RCVDT"] < initial_end else "2"
        account.book((share["AL_FNDID"], pot), amount, trade_day, trade_day - dt.timedelta(days=1), ISSUE)

    def order(self, event, account, trade_day):
        """Withdrawal, surrender, death claim or switch: EV_PCTG of the units of each pot (of EV_FNDID) are sold."""
        sources = [key for key in account.holdings() if event["EV_EVTTP"] != SWITCH or key[0] == event["EV_FNDID"]]
        for key in sources:
            units = -(account.units[key] * event["EV_PCTG"]).quantize(UNIT, era_rounding(trade_day))
            fx = self.market.fx(key[0], account.currency, trade_day)
            amount = cents(units * self.market.price(key[0], trade_day) * fx, era_rounding(trade_day))
            account.units[key] += units
            if event["EV_EVTTP"] == SWITCH:  # the amount buys units of EV_TOFND in the same pot, at the bid price
                account.book((event["EV_TOFND"], key[1]), -amount, trade_day)

    def charge_run(self, event, account, trade_day):
        """The monthly charges of every holding: admin fee, management charge and risk charge, in this order.

        The admin fee and the risk charge are split by the value of the holdings; the risk charge sees the value
        after the admin fee and the management charge.
        """
        keys, rounding = account.holdings(), era_rounding(trade_day)
        values = {key: account.value(key, trade_day) for key in keys}
        if not keys:
            return
        tariff_key = self.risk["RK_TARKEY"]
        tariff = valid(self.tariffs[tariff_key[:2], tariff_key[3:5]], "CG", trade_day)
        admin = split(tariff["CG_ADMFEE"], values, rounding)
        management = {key: self.management_charge(tariff, key, values[key], trade_day) for key in keys}
        net = {key: values[key] - admin[key] - management[key] for key in keys}
        risk = split(self.risk_charge(tariff, sum(net.values()), trade_day), net, rounding)
        for key in keys:
            account.book(key, -(admin[key] + management[key] + risk[key]), trade_day)

    def management_charge(self, tariff, key, value, day_):
        """Yearly rate of the pot (or agreed rate) / 12; the COBOL version took days since the last anniversary / 360."""
        rate = self.agreed_rate(self.policy_id, "AMC", day_) or tariff["CG_AMCP1" if key[1] == "1" else "CG_AMCP2"]
        if day_ < SYSTEM_CHANGE:
            start = self.offer["PH_BEGDT"]
            return cents(value * rate * (day_ - add_months(start, months_between(start, day_) - 1)).days / 360,
                         ROUND_DOWN)
        return cents(value * rate / 12)

    def risk_charge(self, tariff, value, day_):
        """Sum at risk x qx x (1 + loading) x smoker factor / 12, with the ages of t2 (COBOL offers: days / 365)."""
        person = self.persons[self.risk["RK_PERNR"]]
        birth = person["PS_BIRTH"] or day(person["PS_BIRTH_RAW"], month_end=True)
        start, tariff_key = self.offer["PH_BEGDT"], self.risk["RK_TARKEY"]
        years = policy_years(start, day_)
        if self.offer["PH_APPDT"] < SYSTEM_CHANGE:
            insured_age = ((start - birth).days + 182) // 365 + years
        else:
            insured_age = age(birth, add_months(add_months(start, 12 * years), 6))
        sex = {"M": "1", "W": "2"}.get(tariff_key[2], person["PS_SEX"])
        death_rate = self.mortality[tariff["CG_MORTTB"], sex, insured_age]["MO_QX"]
        smoker_factor = tariff["CG_SMKFAC"] if person["PS_SMOKE"] in SMOKER else 1
        sum_at_risk = {"A": value / 100, "B": max(self.risk["RK_SUMIN"] - value, 0), "C": self.risk["RK_SUMIN"]}
        return cents(sum_at_risk[tariff_key[6]] * death_rate * (1 + self.risk["RK_LOAD"]) * smoker_factor / 12,
                     era_rounding(day_))


def t3_surrender_value(legacy_dir, valuation_dates: list[dt.date]) -> dict[tuple[str, dt.date], Decimal]:
    """{(policy_id, valuation_date): surrender_value} of the policies started on or before the valuation date.

    policy value = sum of units x bid price x FX per fund and pot, each rounded to the cent;
    surrender value = policy value x (1 - NRSURR penalty of the product scale and the completed policy years),
    no penalty in an NRWAIV period, 0 for surrendered and death claim policies and for a negative value.
    """
    accounting = FundAccounting(legacy_dir)
    market, products = accounting.market, accounting.products
    penalties = {(row["SR_SCALE"], row["SR_YEAR"]): row["SR_RATE"] for row in table(legacy_dir, "NRSURR")}
    waivers = table(legacy_dir, "NRWAIV")
    result = {}
    for policy_id, versions in accounting.policies.items():
        start = min(versions, key=lambda version: version["PH_VRSNR"])["PH_BEGDT"]
        for valuation_date, units in accounting.holdings(policy_id, valuation_dates).items():
            policy_header, rounding = valid(versions, "PH", valuation_date), era_rounding(valuation_date)
            if start > valuation_date:
                continue
            policy_value = sum(cents(unit_count * market.price(fund, valuation_date)
                                     * market.fx(fund, policy_header["PH_CCY"], valuation_date), rounding)
                               for (fund, _), unit_count in units.items())
            penalty = penalties.get((products[policy_header["PH_PRDCD"]]["PD_SRPSCL"],
                                     policy_years(start, valuation_date)), 0)
            if any(waiver["WV_VLDFR"] <= valuation_date <= waiver["WV_VLDTO"] for waiver in waivers):
                penalty = 0
            closed = policy_header["PH_STATE"] in CLOSED
            result[policy_id, valuation_date] = Decimal(0) if closed else max(cents(policy_value * (1 - penalty),
                                                                                   rounding), Decimal(0))
    return result

"""Neuron migration challenge: the formulas found by the lab pipeline (clustering + optimal trees + exact score).

Each function gets the folder `legacy_dir` with the NR*.csv files and returns the calculated values.
Dates are `datetime.date`, amounts are `decimal.Decimal`. Every value is calculated from `legacy_dir`; only
t5 reads target files. The shared helpers (typed tables, versions, rounding) are in `neuron.py`.
"""
import datetime as dt
import functools
from collections import defaultdict
from decimal import ROUND_DOWN, ROUND_HALF_UP, Decimal

from neuron import cents, grouped, keyed, read_targets, table, valid
from neuron import add_months, age, day, easter, months_between
from neuron import Market, latest


def t0_commission(legacy_dir):
    """amount = PR_AMTRC x NRCOMR.CR_RATE[CR_TIER = BR_TIER@PR_RCVDT, CR_PAYTP = RK_TARKEY[6]], ROUND_HALF_UP.

    Lab candidate C3.1.1: 225848 / 225858 train rows exact (holdout 44051 / 44052).
    """
    commission_rates = keyed(table(legacy_dir, "NRCOMR"), "CR_TIER", "CR_PAYTP")
    policy_headers = grouped(table(legacy_dir, "NRPOLH"), "PH_POLNR")
    brokers = keyed(table(legacy_dir, "NRBROK"), "BR_BRKNR")
    insured_risks = keyed(table(legacy_dir, "NRRISK"), "RK_POLNR")
    result = {}
    for premium_item in table(legacy_dir, "NRPREM"):
        if premium_item["PR_STATE"] == "P":
            policy_header = valid(policy_headers[premium_item["PR_POLNR"]], "PH", premium_item["PR_RCVDT"])
            broker = brokers[policy_header["PH_BRKNR"]]
            insured_risk = insured_risks[premium_item["PR_POLNR"]]
            commission_rate = commission_rates[broker["BR_TIER"], insured_risk["RK_TARKEY"][5]]["CR_RATE"]
            result[premium_item["PR_POLNR"], premium_item["PR_DUENR"]] = cents(premium_item["PR_AMTRC"] * commission_rate)
    return result


MONTHS_PER_DUE = {"M": 1, "Q": 3, "H": 6, "J": 12}  # NRCODE FREQ; E (single premium) has no due dates
SYSTEM_CHANGE = dt.date(2007, 8, 11)
FIXED_HOLIDAYS = {(1, 1), (1, 6), (3, 19), (5, 1), (6, 29), (8, 1), (8, 15), (11, 1), (12, 8), (12, 25), (12, 26)}
EASTER_HOLIDAYS = (1, 39, 50, 60)  # days after Easter: Easter Monday, Ascension, Whit Monday, Corpus Christi


def is_bank_holiday(day):
    """Weekend or holiday of the Ticino calendar (Good Friday is a working day)."""
    return (day.weekday() >= 5 or (day.month, day.day) in FIXED_HOLIDAYS
            or (day - easter(day.year)).days in EASTER_HOLIDAYS)


def t1_next_due_dates(legacy_dir, extract_date: dt.date) -> dict[tuple[str, int], tuple[dt.date, dt.date]]:
    """{(policy_id, n): (due_date, collection_date)} for the due dates in the year after `extract_date`, n = 1, 2, ...

    Policies in force and premium paying (PH_STATE 10) on the extract date. Before the system change the due
    dates were computed one from the other, so a day missing in a month (the 31st) stuck for good; since then
    they are counted from the last due date before the change. Direct debits (LS) are collected on the next
    bank working day, bank transfers (UB) on the due date.
    """
    year_end = add_months(extract_date, 12)
    result = {}
    for policy_id, versions in grouped(table(legacy_dir, "NRPOLH"), "PH_POLNR").items():
        policy_header = valid(versions, "PH", extract_date)
        months = MONTHS_PER_DUE.get(policy_header["PH_FREQ"])
        if policy_header["PH_STATE"] != 10 or not months:
            continue
        anchor = policy_header["PH_BEGDT"]
        while add_months(anchor, months) < SYSTEM_CHANGE:
            anchor = add_months(anchor, months)
        elapsed = (extract_date.year - anchor.year) * 12 + extract_date.month - anchor.month
        k = max(elapsed // months - 1, 0)  # a due number before the extract date, 0 = the begin date
        n = 0
        while (due_date := add_months(anchor, k * months)) <= year_end:
            if due_date > extract_date:
                collection_date = due_date
                while policy_header["PH_PAYMT"] == "LS" and is_bank_holiday(collection_date):
                    collection_date += dt.timedelta(days=1)
                n += 1
                result[policy_id, n] = due_date, collection_date
            k += 1
    return result


SMOKER = {"Y", "J"}  # NRPERS.PS_SMOKE: J (German ja) also means yes


def t2_projected_maturity_value(legacy_dir) -> dict[str, Decimal]:
    """{policy_id: maturity_value}, the value projected by the offer: the first policy version, with the
    parameters valid on the application date.

    Every month from the start date: the premium net of the entry charge comes in on its due months, then the
    admin fee, the management charge (pot 2 rate) and the risk charge go out, then the value grows by a twelfth
    of the yearly NRILLU rate. The risk charge uses the entry age plus the completed policy years.
    The COBOL version (offers applied before the system change) cuts the cents off and takes the entry age as
    days / 365, rounded; the Java version rounds half up and takes the age at the nearest birthday.
    """
    policy_headers = grouped(table(legacy_dir, "NRPOLH"), "PH_POLNR")
    brokers = keyed(table(legacy_dir, "NRBROK"), "BR_BRKNR")
    persons = keyed(table(legacy_dir, "NRPERS"), "PS_PERNR")
    tariffs = grouped(table(legacy_dir, "NRCHRG"), "CG_TARFAM", "CG_TARGEN")
    entry_rates = grouped(table(legacy_dir, "NRENTC"), "EC_TIER")
    mortality = keyed(table(legacy_dir, "NRMORT"), "MO_TABID", "MO_SEX", "MO_AGE")
    result = {}
    for insured_risk in table(legacy_dir, "NRRISK"):
        offer = min(policy_headers[insured_risk["RK_POLNR"]], key=lambda version: version["PH_VRSNR"])
        applied, start = offer["PH_APPDT"], offer["PH_BEGDT"]
        tariff_key = insured_risk["RK_TARKEY"]
        tariff = valid(tariffs[tariff_key[:2], tariff_key[3:5]], "CG", applied)
        entry_rate = valid(entry_rates[brokers[offer["PH_BRKNR"]]["BR_TIER"]], "EC", applied)["EC_RATE"]
        growth = 1 + valid(table(legacy_dir, "NRILLU"), "IL", applied)["IL_RATE"] / 12
        person = persons[insured_risk["RK_PERNR"]]
        birth = person["PS_BIRTH"] or day(person["PS_BIRTH_RAW"], month_end=True)  # 31 September: 30 September
        sex = {"M": "1", "W": "2"}.get(tariff_key[2], person["PS_SEX"])
        smoker_factor = tariff["CG_SMKFAC"] if person["PS_SMOKE"] in SMOKER else 1
        step = MONTHS_PER_DUE.get(offer["PH_FREQ"])  # None: a single premium, paid in month 0 only
        if applied < SYSTEM_CHANGE:
            rounding, entry_age = ROUND_DOWN, ((start - birth).days + 182) // 365
        else:
            rounding, entry_age = ROUND_HALF_UP, age(birth, add_months(start, 6))
        value = Decimal(0)
        for month in range(months_between(start, offer["PH_ENDDT"])):
            if (month % step if step else month) == 0:
                value += cents(offer["PH_PREMI"] * (1 - entry_rate), rounding)
            value -= tariff["CG_ADMFEE"]
            value -= cents(value * tariff["CG_AMCP2"] / 12, rounding)
            death_rate = mortality[tariff["CG_MORTTB"], sex, entry_age + month // 12]["MO_QX"]
            sum_at_risk = {"A": value / 100, "B": max(insured_risk["RK_SUMIN"] - value, 0),
                           "C": insured_risk["RK_SUMIN"]}[tariff_key[6]]
            value -= cents(sum_at_risk * death_rate * (1 + insured_risk["RK_LOAD"]) * smoker_factor / 12, rounding)
            value = cents(value * growth, rounding)
        result[insured_risk["RK_POLNR"]] = value
    return result


def t3_surrender_value(legacy_dir, valuation_dates: list[dt.date]) -> dict[tuple[str, dt.date], Decimal]:
    """{(policy_id, valuation_date): surrender_value}"""
    return {}


def t4_annual_statement(legacy_dir) -> dict[tuple[str, int], tuple[Decimal, ...]]:
    """{(policy_id, year): (premiums, entry_charges, admin_fees, management_fees, risk_charges, total_charges)}"""
    return {}


EXTRACT_DATE = dt.date(2026, 6, 30)  # the extract date of t1_next_due_dates
CHECKED = {  # task: (function, key converters, value converters, its arguments after legacy_dir from targets_dir)
    "t0_commission": (t0_commission, (str, int), (Decimal,), lambda targets_dir: ()),
    "t1_next_due_dates": (t1_next_due_dates, (str, int), (dt.date.fromisoformat,) * 2,
                          lambda targets_dir: (EXTRACT_DATE,)),
    "t2_projected_maturity_value": (t2_projected_maturity_value, (str,), (Decimal,), lambda targets_dir: ()),
}


def t5_outlier_detection(legacy_dir, targets_dir) -> set[tuple[str, object]]:
    """{(task, key)} of the target values that differ from the rules: the values that were changed by hand."""
    outliers = set()
    for task, (rule, key_types, value_types, arguments) in CHECKED.items():
        computed = rule(legacy_dir, *arguments(targets_dir))
        for key, value in read_targets(targets_dir, task, key_types, value_types).items():
            if key in computed and computed[key] != value:
                outliers.add((task, key))
    return outliers

"""The frozen submission: same score as the lab (scoring.accuracy), no target files read outside t5."""
import builtins
import sys

import polars as pl
import pytest

from neuronlab import evaluate, frame, paths, store

sys.path.insert(0, str(paths.SUBMISSION))
import submission  # noqa: E402
import scoring  # noqa: E402  (store puts the starter kit on sys.path)

LEGACY = str(paths.LEGACY)


def test_t0_matches_the_lab_and_the_official_scoring():
    predictions = submission.t0_commission(LEGACY)
    targets = scoring.read_targets(paths.TARGETS, "t0_commission")
    assert scoring.accuracy("t0_commission", predictions, targets) == (225848, 225858)
    df, meta = frame.load("t0_commission")
    pool = __import__("json").loads((paths.run_dir("t0_commission") / "pool.json").read_text())
    info = pool["values"]["amount"]
    best = next(c for c in info["candidates"] if c["id"] == info["best"])
    lab = df.select("policy_id", "due_nr").with_columns(evaluate.predicted(df, best, "amount").alias("p"))
    assert all(predictions[(p, d)] == v for p, d, v in lab.iter_rows())


def test_t5_reports_the_manual_corrections():
    outliers = submission.t5_outlier_detection(LEGACY, str(paths.TARGETS))

"""Neuron migration challenge: the formulas found by the lab pipeline (clustering + optimal trees + exact score).

Each function gets the folder `legacy_dir` with the NR*.csv files and returns the calculated values.
Dates are `datetime.date`, amounts are `decimal.Decimal`. Every value is calculated from `legacy_dir`; only
t5 reads target files. The shared helpers (typed tables, versions, rounding) are in `neuron.py`.
"""
import datetime as dt
import functools
from collections import defaultdict
from decimal import ROUND_DOWN, ROUND_HALF_UP, Decimal

from neuron import cents, grouped, keyed, read_targets, table, valid
from neuron import add_months, age, day, easter, months_between
from neuron import Market, latest


def t0_commission(legacy_dir):
    """amount = PR_AMTRC x NRCOMR.CR_RATE[CR_TIER = BR_TIER@PR_RCVDT, CR_PAYTP = RK_TARKEY[6]], ROUND_HALF_UP.

    Lab candidate C3.1.1: 225848 / 225858 train rows exact (holdout 44051 / 44052).
    """
    commission_rates = keyed(table(legacy_dir, "NRCOMR"), "CR_TIER", "CR_PAYTP")
    policy_headers = grouped(table(legacy_dir, "NRPOLH"), "PH_POLNR")
    brokers = keyed(table(legacy_dir, "NRBROK"), "BR_BRKNR")
    insured_risks = keyed(table(legacy_dir, "NRRISK"), "RK_POLNR")
    result = {}
    for premium_item in table(legacy_dir, "NRPREM"):
        if premium_item["PR_STATE"] == "P":
            policy_header = valid(policy_headers[premium_item["PR_POLNR"]], "PH", premium_item["PR_RCVDT"])
            broker = brokers[policy_header["PH_BRKNR"]]
            insured_risk = insured_risks[premium_item["PR_POLNR"]]
            commission_rate = commission_rates[broker["BR_TIER"], insured_risk["RK_TARKEY"][5]]["CR_RATE"]
            result[premium_item["PR_POLNR"], premium_item["PR_DUENR"]] = cents(premium_item["PR_AMTRC"] * commission_rate)
    return result


MONTHS_PER_DUE = {"M": 1, "Q": 3, "H": 6, "J": 12}  # NRCODE FREQ; E (single premium) has no due dates
SYSTEM_CHANGE = dt.date(2007, 8, 11)
FIXED_HOLIDAYS = {(1, 1), (1, 6), (3, 19), (5, 1), (6, 29), (8, 1), (8, 15), (11, 1), (12, 8), (12, 25), (12, 26)}
EASTER_HOLIDAYS = (1, 39, 50, 60)  # days after Easter: Easter Monday, Ascension, Whit Monday, Corpus Christi


def is_bank_holiday(day):
    """Weekend or holiday of the Ticino calendar (Good Friday is a working day)."""
    return (day.weekday() >= 5 or (day.month, day.day) in FIXED_HOLIDAYS
            or (day - easter(day.year)).days in EASTER_HOLIDAYS)


def t1_next_due_dates(legacy_dir, extract_date: dt.date) -> dict[tuple[str, int], tuple[dt.date, dt.date]]:
    """{(policy_id, n): (due_date, collection_date)} for the due dates in the year after `extract_date`, n = 1, 2, ...

    Policies in force and premium paying (PH_STATE 10) on the extract date. Before the system change the due
    dates were computed one from the other, so a day missing in a month (the 31st) stuck for good; since then
    they are counted from the last due date before the change. Direct debits (LS) are collected on the next
    bank working day, bank transfers (UB) on the due date.
    """
    year_end = add_months(extract_date, 12)
    result = {}
    for policy_id, versions in grouped(table(legacy_dir, "NRPOLH"), "PH_POLNR").items():
        policy_header = valid(versions, "PH", extract_date)
        months = MONTHS_PER_DUE.get(policy_header["PH_FREQ"])
        if policy_header["PH_STATE"] != 10 or not months:
            continue
        anchor = policy_header["PH_BEGDT"]
        while add_months(anchor, months) < SYSTEM_CHANGE:
            anchor = add_months(anchor, months)
        elapsed = (extract_date.year - anchor.year) * 12 + extract_date.month - anchor.month
        k = max(elapsed // months - 1, 0)  # a due number before the extract date, 0 = the begin date
        n = 0
        while (due_date := add_months(anchor, k * months)) <= year_end:
            if due_date > extract_date:
                collection_date = due_date
                while policy_header["PH_PAYMT"] == "LS" and is_bank_holiday(collection_date):
                    collection_date += dt.timedelta(days=1)
                n += 1
                result[policy_id, n] = due_date, collection_date
            k += 1
    return result


SMOKER = {"Y", "J"}  # NRPERS.PS_SMOKE: J (German ja) also means yes


def t2_projected_maturity_value(legacy_dir) -> dict[str, Decimal]:
    """{policy_id: maturity_value}, the value projected by the offer: the first policy version, with the
    parameters valid on the application date.

    Every month from the start date: the premium net of the entry charge comes in on its due months, then the
    admin fee, the management charge (pot 2 rate) and the risk charge go out, then the value grows by a twelfth
    of the yearly NRILLU rate. The risk charge uses the entry age plus the completed policy years.
    The COBOL version (offers applied before the system change) cuts the cents off and takes the entry age as
    days / 365, rounded; the Java version rounds half up and takes the age at the nearest birthday.
    """
    policy_headers = grouped(table(legacy_dir, "NRPOLH"), "PH_POLNR")
    brokers = keyed(table(legacy_dir, "NRBROK"), "BR_BRKNR")
    persons = keyed(table(legacy_dir, "NRPERS"), "PS_PERNR")
    tariffs = grouped(table(legacy_dir, "NRCHRG"), "CG_TARFAM", "CG_TARGEN")
    entry_rates = grouped(table(legacy_dir, "NRENTC"), "EC_TIER")
    mortality = keyed(table(legacy_dir, "NRMORT"), "MO_TABID", "MO_SEX", "MO_AGE")
    result = {}
    for insured_risk in table(legacy_dir, "NRRISK"):
        offer = min(policy_headers[insured_risk["RK_POLNR"]], key=lambda version: version["PH_VRSNR"])
        applied, start = offer["PH_APPDT"], offer["PH_BEGDT"]
        tariff_key = insured_risk["RK_TARKEY"]
        tariff = valid(tariffs[tariff_key[:2], tariff_key[3:5]], "CG", applied)
        entry_rate = valid(entry_rates[brokers[offer["PH_BRKNR"]]["BR_TIER"]], "EC", applied)["EC_RATE"]
        growth = 1 + valid(table(legacy_dir, "NRILLU"), "IL", applied)["IL_RATE"] / 12
        person = persons[insured_risk["RK_PERNR"]]
        birth = person["PS_BIRTH"] or day(person["PS_BIRTH_RAW"], month_end=True)  # 31 September: 30 September
        sex = {"M": "1", "W": "2"}.get(tariff_key[2], person["PS_SEX"])
        smoker_factor = tariff["CG_SMKFAC"] if person["PS_SMOKE"] in SMOKER else 1
        step = MONTHS_PER_DUE.get(offer["PH_FREQ"])  # None: a single premium, paid in month 0 only
        if applied < SYSTEM_CHANGE:
            rounding, entry_age = ROUND_DOWN, ((start - birth).days + 182) // 365
        else:
            rounding, entry_age = ROUND_HALF_UP, age(birth, add_months(start, 6))
        value = Decimal(0)
        for month in range(months_between(start, offer["PH_ENDDT"])):
            if (month % step if step else month) == 0:
                value += cents(offer["PH_PREMI"] * (1 - entry_rate), rounding)
            value -= tariff["CG_ADMFEE"]
            value -= cents(value * tariff["CG_AMCP2"] / 12, rounding)
            death_rate = mortality[tariff["CG_MORTTB"], sex, entry_age + month // 12]["MO_QX"]
            sum_at_risk = {"A": value / 100, "B": max(insured_risk["RK_SUMIN"] - value, 0),
                           "C": insured_risk["RK_SUMIN"]}[tariff_key[6]]
            value -= cents(sum_at_risk * death_rate * (1 + insured_risk["RK_LOAD"]) * smoker_factor / 12, rounding)
            value = cents(value * growth, rounding)
        result[insured_risk["RK_POLNR"]] = value
    return result


REDEMPTION, ISSUE = "FP_BIDPR", "FP_ASKPR"  # NRFPRC: units are sold at the bid and bought at the ask price
UNIT = Decimal("0.000001")
CHARGE_RUN, SWITCH = 300, 200  # NRCODE EVTTP
CUSTOMER_ORDERS = {200, 400, 410, 500}  # switch, withdrawal, surrender, death claim: EV_PCTG of the units are sold
CLOSED = {60, 70}  # NRCODE STATE: surrendered, death claim


def era_rounding(day_):
    """Neuron NG rounds half up; the COBOL version (before the system change) cuts cents and units off."""
    return ROUND_DOWN if day_ < SYSTEM_CHANGE else ROUND_HALF_UP


def policy_years(start, day_):
    """Completed policy years; a policy that starts on 29 February completes a year on 28 February."""
    years = age(start, day_)
    return years + (add_months(start, 12 * (years + 1)) <= day_)


def split(total, weights, rounding):
    """`total` in proportion to the weights, each part rounded; the largest weight takes the rounding difference."""
    total_weight = sum(weights.values()) or 1
    parts = {key: cents(total * weight / total_weight, rounding) for key, weight in weights.items()}
    parts[max(weights, key=weights.get)] += total - sum(parts.values())
    return parts


class FundAccount:
    """The units of one policy per (fund, pot), valued and booked in the policy currency."""

    def __init__(self, market, currency):
        self.market, self.currency, self.units = market, currency, defaultdict(Decimal)

    def holdings(self):
        return [key for key, units in self.units.items() if units > 0]

    def value(self, key, day_):
        """Redemption value of one holding on `day_`, rounded to the cent."""
        fx = self.market.fx(key[0], self.currency, day_)
        return cents(self.units[key] * self.market.price(key[0], day_) * fx, era_rounding(day_))

    def book(self, key, amount, day_, fx_day=None, side=REDEMPTION):
        """Buys (amount > 0) or cancels (amount < 0) the units of an amount in the policy currency."""
        unit_price = self.market.price(key[0], day_, side) * self.market.fx(key[0], self.currency, fx_day or day_)
        self.units[key] += (amount / unit_price).quantize(UNIT, era_rounding(day_))


class FundAccounting:
    """Neuron's unit accounting, rebuilt from the premiums, the events, the parameters and the market data.

    NRBOOK is not read: its premium and charge bookings have no amounts, and the units of the customer orders
    follow from EV_PCTG. Reversed events (900) and technical corrections (990) do not count.
    """

    def __init__(self, legacy_dir):
        self.market = Market(legacy_dir)
        self.policies = grouped(table(legacy_dir, "NRPOLH"), "PH_POLNR")
        self.risks = keyed(table(legacy_dir, "NRRISK"), "RK_POLNR")
        self.persons = keyed(table(legacy_dir, "NRPERS"), "PS_PERNR")
        self.products = keyed(table(legacy_dir, "NRPROD"), "PD_PRDCD")
        self.brokers = keyed(table(legacy_dir, "NRBROK"), "BR_BRKNR")
        self.tariffs = grouped(table(legacy_dir, "NRCHRG"), "CG_TARFAM", "CG_TARGEN")
        self.entry_rates = grouped(table(legacy_dir, "NRENTC"), "EC_TIER")
        self.mortality = keyed(table(legacy_dir, "NRMORT"), "MO_TABID", "MO_SEX", "MO_AGE")
        self.agreements = grouped(table(legacy_dir, "NRAGRE"), "AG_POLNR", "AG_FEETP")
        self.allocations = grouped(table(legacy_dir, "NRALLO"), "AL_POLNR")
        self.events = grouped(table(legacy_dir, "NREVNT"), "EV_POLNR")
        self.premiums = grouped(table(legacy_dir, "NRPREM"), "PR_POLNR")

    def agreed_rate(self, policy_id, fee_type, day_):
        """The rate of an individual NRAGRE agreement valid on `day_`, which replaces the tariff rate."""
        for agreement in self.agreements.get((policy_id, fee_type), []):
            if agreement["AG_VLDFR"] <= day_ <= agreement["AG_VLDTO"]:
                return agreement["AG_RATE"]
        return None

    def holdings(self, policy_id, days):
        """{day: FundAccount units} at the end of each of `days`.

        The bookings are processed by trade date; on the same day the charge run comes before the premiums and
        orders, which are processed in the order of their events.
        """
        self.policy_id, versions = policy_id, self.policies[policy_id]
        self.offer, self.risk = min(versions, key=lambda version: version["PH_VRSNR"]), self.risks[policy_id]
        account = FundAccount(self.market, latest(versions, "PH")["PH_CCY"])
        events = self.events.get(policy_id, [])
        reversed_events = {event["EV_REVNR"] for event in events if event["EV_EVTTP"] == 900}
        bookings = [(event["EV_EFFDT"], event["EV_EVTTP"] != CHARGE_RUN, event["EV_EVTNR"],
                     functools.partial(self.charge_run if event["EV_EVTTP"] == CHARGE_RUN else self.order, event))
                    for event in events
                    if event["EV_EVTTP"] in CUSTOMER_ORDERS | {CHARGE_RUN} and event["EV_EVTNR"] not in reversed_events]
        bookings += self.premium_bookings(versions)
        result, pending = {}, sorted(days)
        for trade_day, _, _, book in sorted(bookings, key=lambda booking: booking[:3]):
            while pending and pending[0] < trade_day:
                result[pending.pop(0)] = dict(account.units)
            book(account, trade_day)
        return result | {valuation_date: dict(account.units) for valuation_date in pending}

    def premium_bookings(self, versions):
        """Each paid premium (PR_STATE P) is invested on the first price date of each fund after the money date."""
        bookings = []
        for premium in self.premiums.get(self.policy_id, []):
            received = premium["PR_RCVDT"]
            if premium["PR_STATE"] != "P":
                continue
            entry_rate = self.agreed_rate(self.policy_id, "ENT", received)
            if entry_rate is None:
                broker = self.brokers[valid(versions, "PH", received)["PH_BRKNR"]]
                entry_rate = valid(self.entry_rates[broker["BR_TIER"]], "EC", received)["EC_RATE"]
            allocation = self.allocations[self.policy_id]
            version = valid(allocation, "AL", received)["AL_VRSNR"]
            for share in (share for share in allocation if share["AL_VRSNR"] == version):
                trade_day = self.market.price_day(share["AL_FNDID"], received, after=True)
                invest = functools.partial(self.invest, premium, share, entry_rate)
                bookings.append((trade_day, True, premium["PR_EVTNR"], invest))
        return bookings

    def invest(self, premium, share, entry_rate, account, trade_day):
        """Net premium x allocation share at the ask price; pot 1 for the money received in the initial months."""
        amount = cents(premium["PR_AMTRC"] * (1 - entry_rate) * share["AL_PCTG"], era_rounding(trade_day))
        initial_end = add_months(self.offer["PH_BEGDT"], self.products[self.offer["PH_PRDCD"]]["PD_INIMON"])
        pot = "1" if premium["PR_RCVDT"] < initial_end else "2"
        account.book((share["AL_FNDID"], pot), amount, trade_day, trade_day - dt.timedelta(days=1), ISSUE)

    def order(self, event, account, trade_day):
        """Withdrawal, surrender, death claim or switch: EV_PCTG of the units of each pot (of EV_FNDID) are sold."""
        sources = [key for key in account.holdings() if event["EV_EVTTP"] != SWITCH or key[0] == event["EV_FNDID"]]
        for key in sources:
            units = -(account.units[key] * event["EV_PCTG"]).quantize(UNIT, era_rounding(trade_day))
            fx = self.market.fx(key[0], account.currency, trade_day)
            amount = cents(units * self.market.price(key[0], trade_day) * fx, era_rounding(trade_day))
            account.units[key] += units
            if event["EV_EVTTP"] == SWITCH:  # the amount buys units of EV_TOFND in the same pot, at the bid price
                account.book((event["EV_TOFND"], key[1]), -amount, trade_day)

    def charge_run(self, event, account, trade_day):
        """The monthly charges of every holding: admin fee, management charge and risk charge, in this order.

        The admin fee and the risk charge are split by the value of the holdings; the risk charge sees the value
        after the admin fee and the management charge.
        """
        keys, rounding = account.holdings(), era_rounding(trade_day)
        if not keys:
            return
        values = {key: account.value(key, trade_day) for key in keys}
        tariff_key = self.risk["RK_TARKEY"]
        tariff = valid(self.tariffs[tariff_key[:2], tariff_key[3:5]], "CG", trade_day)
        admin = split(tariff["CG_ADMFEE"], values, rounding)
        management = {key: self.management_charge(tariff, key, values[key], trade_day) for key in keys}
        net = {key: values[key] - admin[key] - management[key] for key in keys}
        risk = split(self.risk_charge(tariff, sum(net.values()), trade_day), net, rounding)
        for key in keys:
            for charge in (admin, management, risk):  # one booking per charge, each with its own unit rounding
                account.book(key, -charge[key], trade_day)

    def management_charge(self, tariff, key, value, day_):
        """Yearly rate of the pot (or agreed rate) / 12; the COBOL version took days since the last anniversary / 360."""
        rate = self.agreed_rate(self.policy_id, "AMC", day_)
        if rate is None:
            rate = tariff["CG_AMCP1" if key[1] == "1" else "CG_AMCP2"]
        if day_ < SYSTEM_CHANGE:
            start = self.offer["PH_BEGDT"]
            return cents(value * rate * (day_ - add_months(start, months_between(start, day_) - 1)).days / 360,
                         ROUND_DOWN)
        return cents(value * rate / 12)

    def risk_charge(self, tariff, value, day_):
        """Sum at risk x qx x (1 + loading) x smoker factor / 12, with the ages of t2 (COBOL offers: days / 365)."""
        person = self.persons[self.risk["RK_PERNR"]]
        birth = person["PS_BIRTH"] or day(person["PS_BIRTH_RAW"], month_end=True)
        start, tariff_key = self.offer["PH_BEGDT"], self.risk["RK_TARKEY"]
        years = policy_years(start, day_)
        if self.offer["PH_APPDT"] < SYSTEM_CHANGE:
            insured_age = ((start - birth).days + 182) // 365 + years
        else:
            insured_age = age(birth, add_months(add_months(start, 12 * years), 6))
        sex = {"M": "1", "W": "2"}.get(tariff_key[2], person["PS_SEX"])
        death_rate = self.mortality[tariff["CG_MORTTB"], sex, insured_age]["MO_QX"]
        smoker_factor = tariff["CG_SMKFAC"] if person["PS_SMOKE"] in SMOKER else 1
        sum_at_risk = {"A": value / 100, "B": max(self.risk["RK_SUMIN"] - value, 0), "C": self.risk["RK_SUMIN"]}
        return cents(sum_at_risk[tariff_key[6]] * death_rate * (1 + self.risk["RK_LOAD"]) * smoker_factor / 12,
                     era_rounding(day_))

    """{(policy_id, valuation_date): surrender_value} of the policies started on or before the valuation date.

    policy value = sum of units x bid price x FX per fund and pot, each rounded to the cent;
    surrender value = policy value x (1 - NRSURR penalty of the product scale and the completed policy years),
    no penalty in an NRWAIV period, 0 for surrendered and death claim policies and for a negative value.
    """
    accounting = FundAccounting(legacy_dir)
    market, products = accounting.market, accounting.products
    penalties = {(row["SR_SCALE"], row["SR_YEAR"]): row["SR_RATE"] for row in table(legacy_dir, "NRSURR")}
    waivers = table(legacy_dir, "NRWAIV")
    result = {}
    for policy_id, versions in accounting.policies.items():
        start = min(versions, key=lambda version: version["PH_VRSNR"])["PH_BEGDT"]
        for valuation_date, units in accounting.holdings(policy_id, valuation_dates).items():
            policy_header, rounding = valid(versions, "PH", valuation_date), era_rounding(valuation_date)
            if start > valuation_date:

                                     * market.fx(fund, latest(versions, "PH")["PH_CCY"], valuation_date), rounding)

## 2026-10-17, written function (step 4b): 6137 / 6153, holdout 1238 / 1241

No lab candidate is usable: the best one, C2.2/DOWN (5548 / 6153, holdout 1118 / 1241), is a relation to
`policy_value`, a diagnostic column the submission may not read. The policy value is a full unit accounting, so I
wrote the function by hand (step 4b). I checked each step in isolation in scratch scripts outside the repo: first
against the diagnostic files (`t3_holding`, `t3_booking` joined to NRBOOK on a tenth of the train policies), then
as one simulation. No feature was added (no `~llm` run), nothing was frozen.

Step by step, each measured with the true inputs of the step before:

| step | rule | exact |
|---|---|---|
| holdings | sum of booking units with BK_TRDDT <= valuation date, without reversed (900) and 990 events | 3129 / 3129 sample holdings |
| policy value | sum per fund and pot of cents(units x bid x FX); COBOL dates (before 2007-08-11) ROUND_DOWN | 6153 / 6153 |
| surrender value | policy value x (1 - penalty), see below | 6137 / 6153 |
| PRM amount | cents(PR_AMTRC x (1 - entry rate) x allocation share) per fund | 24309 / 24309 sample events |
| ADM split | CG_ADMFEE pro rata to the fund values, the largest holding takes the rounding difference | 41353 / 41459 runs |
| RSK | t2 formula on the value after ADM and AMC, split pro rata to the values after ADM and AMC | 30590 / 30598 runs |
| simulation, 1 in 10 train policies | everything, from the legacy tables only | 607 / 607 policy values |

`lab score` history (ledger.jsonl): the first scored version gave 6137 / 6153 (holdout 1238 / 1241). check.py with
the system Python gives the same, 27 s. NRBOOK is not read (it is only named in a docstring).

Rules (in `FundAccounting` in submission.py, `Market` in neuron.py):
- **Market:** the latest publication (FP_CHGTS) of a price counts. Prices are looked up on the last price date on
  or before the day. FX = CHF rate of the fund currency / CHF rate of the policy currency, on the last rate date on
  or before the day, not rounded. Some NRFXRT codes are in lower case (`chf`, `eur`, ...): upper-case them.
- **Units** = amount / (price x FX), rounded to 6 decimals (ROUND_DOWN before 2007-08-11, half up after), one
  rounding per booking. Every booking uses the same formula; only the price side and the FX day differ.
- **Order of processing:** by trade date. On the same day the charge run (300) comes first, then premiums and
  orders by event number. A premium traded on the day of a charge run is not charged that month. An order on that
  day sells after the charges.
- **Premiums (PRM):** NRPREM items with PR_STATE P (state R items are the reversed ones). Entry rate: NRAGRE ENT
  valid on PR_RCVDT, else NRENTC of the broker tier of the policy version valid on PR_RCVDT. Allocation: the
  NRALLO version valid on PR_RCVDT. Amount per fund = cents(PR_AMTRC x (1 - entry rate) x share), era rounding of
  the trade date. Trade date = the first price date of the fund **after** PR_RCVDT. Price = ask on the trade date.
  FX on the day **before** the trade date: it equals the money date except when a fund has no price on the next
  day (35 of 8000 foreign premiums told them apart). Pot 1 when PR_RCVDT < PH_BEGDT + PD_INIMON months, else pot 2.
- **Charge run (300, EV_EFFDT):** on every holding with units > 0; values = cents(units x bid x FX) on the run date.
  - ADM: CG_ADMFEE (NRCHRG of RK_TARKEY family + generation, valid on the run date), split pro rata to the values.
  - AMC per holding: NRAGRE AMC rate if valid, else CG_AMCP1 for pot 1, CG_AMCP2 for pot 2.
    Java: cents(value x rate / 12). COBOL: ROUND_DOWN(value x rate x days / 360), days from the previous monthly
    anniversary add_months(PH_BEGDT, n - 1) (not the previous run: the first anniversary often has no units).
  - RSK: the t2 risk formula (sum at risk A/B/C, qx of CG_MORTTB, 1 + RK_LOAD, smoker factor, / 12) on the value
    after ADM and AMC. Ages as in t2: COBOL offers (PH_APPDT < 2007-08-11) take round(days / 365) at the start plus
    completed policy years, Java offers the age at the nearest birthday at the start of the policy year. Split pro
    rata to the values after ADM and AMC (with the value of the holdings themselves: 827 runs wrong).
  - Three bookings per holding (ADM, AMC, RSK), each with its own unit rounding.
- **Customer orders (200 switch, 400 withdrawal, 410 surrender, 500 death claim, on EV_EFFDT):** units sold per
  pot = round6(units x EV_PCTG) (of EV_FNDID for a switch), amount = cents(units x bid x FX). A switch buys
  EV_TOFND in the same pot with that amount, at the **bid** price (not the ask).
- **Surrender value:** penalty = NRSURR[PD_SRPSCL, completed policy years], 0 inside an NRWAIV period (2020-04-30 is
  in the COVID waiver), 0 when the policy version valid on the valuation date is in state 60/70, never below 0. Era
  rounding of the valuation date. Policy years count anniversaries with add_months, so a policy that starts on
  29 February completes a year on 28 February (BL10002904).
- **Rows:** every policy whose PH_BEGDT <= valuation date (0 keys too many or too few on train).
